result.title: Defence Rebuttal
result.content: The Crown's rebuttal acknowledges the accounts are attributed and disputed, and confirms the Crown bears the burden beyond a reasonable doubt. I agree on those points. Mira describes a handover (E-001), while Tavi states they did not see a handover and saw Fictional Morgan leave with the blue token still in hand (E-002). The limited-use instruction permits assessment of these admitted disputed accounts, but that permission does not convert attributed material into proof of the physical receipt. On the supplied record, the Crown has not established the fictional blue-token receipt condition beyond a reasonable doubt.
